name: ES 5-min Opening Range Breakout (edgeful)
entry: Mark 9:30-9:35 ET high/low; go long on break above range high. Skip if range >0.55% of open; skip Tuesday breakouts.
exit: TP = 50% of range beyond breakout level; SL at opposite range edge; $700 (14 pt) max loss cap.
claimed_stats: Backtest 6 months, 1 ES contract: 115 trades, 72.17% win rate, PF 1.623, +$10,825 (108% on $10k). Drawdown not reported.

name: ORB for Stocks in Play (Zarattini relative-volume ORB)
entry: Top 20 liquid US stocks by first-5-min relative volume (>1). If first 5m bar closed up, buy stop at opening range high at 9:35.
exit: Stop is a multiple of 14-day ATR (10% ATR in the paper); otherwise exit at market close.
claimed_stats: QuantConnect 2016 replication: Sharpe 2.396 vs SPY 0.836, beta -0.042; 17 of 25 parameter sets beat benchmark.

name: 15-min ORB with volume confirmation (Nifty)
entry: 1m candle closes above the 15-minute opening range high on 1.5-2x recent average volume.
exit: SL at range midpoint (aggressive) or opposite range edge; TP = range width projected, or next level; trail after 1x range.
claimed_stats: R:R 1.5:1 to 2:1 (table); no win rate

name: ICT Silver Bullet
entry: In 3-4am, 10-11am or 2-3pm NY window: sweep of liquidity, then displacement leaving an FVG; enter on FVG retest at midpoint.
exit: SL beyond the sweep extreme; TP at opposing liquidity; minimum 2R or skip. One trade per window.

name: ICT Judas Swing
entry: At London open (02-05 NY) or NY open: false push through a marked level, then rejection and displacement back; enter on retrace into displacement FVG.
exit: SL beyond the swept extreme; TP at opposite-side liquidity.

name: Asian Range Sweep in London Killzone
entry: During London killzone, price sweeps the Asia-range low and closes back inside; enter long on retrace to the displacement FVG.
exit: SL beyond the sweep; TP at the opposite side of the Asia range.
claimed_stats: Source says no study exists for this setup

name: ICT Order Block 50% Retest
entry: With HTF bias (BOS/CHoCH), mark a 1H OB with FVG; on 15m retest, after a 5m CHoCH/MSS, buy at 50% of OB body.
exit: SL 5 pips below the OB candle low; TP at next equal high or preceding FVG (liquidity pool).

name: ICT Unicorn (breaker + FVG overlap)
entry: After a lower low then a break toward a higher high, trade only the zone where a bullish FVG overlaps a bullish breaker; long on close back above the overlap.
exit: Structural SL below the zone; TP at prior swing or equal highs; skip if reward is too small.

name: FVG Retest with Rejection (edgeful)
entry: Mark a 30m bullish FVG and confirm on 15m. On the 5m chart, buy at the gap top on touch, or on a close above the gap after a rejection candle.
exit: SL just below the FVG bottom; TP at PDH, IB high, swing level, or gap-size measured move.
claimed_stats: YM, 6 months: 60.71% of bullish and 63.2% of bearish 30m FVGs stayed unmitigated (by close) in the same session.

name: 1H FVG + 15m Engulfing (NAS100 backtest)
entry: Long when price traded into a 1H bullish FVG within the last 12 bars, a 15m bullish engulfing prints, and the 4H close is above its 50 EMA.
exit: SL 100 index points, TP 300 points (1:3).

name: Sweep & Reverse (liquidity sweep reversal)
entry: Long when a bar wicks below a pivot swing low and closes back above it. Optional filters: volume spike, rejection wick, next-bar confirmation, London/NY session.
exit: SL beyond the sweep wick plus an ATR buffer; TP at a user R:R; breakeven partway to target.

name: Prior-Day Low Sweep Fade
entry: Price pierces the prior-day low, then closes back inside yesterday's range within the same or next 5m candle; buy.
exit: SL just beyond the sweep extreme; TP at the middle of yesterday's range or session VWAP.

name: Prior-Day High Breakout
entry: A full-bodied 5m candle closes clearly above the prior-day high on volume well above average (e.g. 2x).
exit: SL beyond the breakout candle extreme; TP = prior-day range width projected; invalid if price closes back inside the range.

name: London Breakout on Gold (Asian range OCO)
entry: At 08:00 server time, place a buy stop above the 03:00-08:00 Asian range high (OCO with a sell stop). Skip if range <0.30% or >1.60%.
exit: SL at the opposite range side, capped at 0.6%; TP 2.5R; breakeven at 1.5R; close all at 21:00.
claimed_stats: MT5 Jan 2023-Sep 2026, 1% risk: PF 1.38, 715 trades, ~49% win, max DD 17.3%; out-of-sample 2026 PF 1.61 (157 trades)

name: London Breakout GBPUSD fixed 20/40 pips
entry: Between 07:00 and 11:00 UTC, a 15m close above the 00:00-06:00 UTC Asian high.
exit: Fixed SL 20 pips, TP 40 pips.
claimed_stats: 2016-2026: 2,432 trades, 33.68% win rate, PF 0.72, -60% total return, max DD -60.4% (losing)

name: Break and Retest (1-minute, incl. pre-market level)
entry: Between 9:30 and 11:00 ET, a candle closes beyond S/R or the pre-market high; on the retest of the level, enter on a 1m confirmation candle close.
exit: SL beyond the retest low (one-candle zone); minimum 1:2 R; scale 25-50% at HOD or first level, run the rest.

name: Breakout Reclaim (failed-break reclaim)
entry: After a failed breakout above resistance, a 1m candle closes back above the level on decent volume.
exit: SL below the reclaim candle low or the level (whichever is tighter); TP 1.5-2x risk or next resistance.
claimed_stats: Example R:R 2:1

name: Range Fade (S/R bounce)
entry: At support tested 3+ times with ADX(14) <25 and steady or declining touch volume, place a limit just inside the level and require a 5m rejection candle.
exit: SL just beyond the level, sized to the widest prior wick; TP1 at range midpoint, TP2 at opposite boundary.

name: Round Number ('00) Level Trading
entry: Watch for repeated tests of a big round number (e.g. 1.0600, 155.00); repeated tests raise the odds of a breakout.
exit: Put the stop slightly beyond the round number; set the TP just before the next round number, where price tends to stall.

name: Pin Bar Reversal
entry: Pin bar (wick ≥2x body) at swing low, VWAP or round number on elevated volume; buy when the next candle closes above the pin body on ≥5-bar average volume.
exit: SL below the pin wick; TP = pin height from entry, scale out half; breakeven once confirmation high is cleared.
claimed_stats: Cites Bulkowski daily-chart hammer: modest majority correct direction; no exact numbers

name: Bullish Engulfing Pullback
entry: In an uptrend pullback, an engulfing candle's body covers the prior body on clearly higher volume. Buy at its close or on the next close above its high.
exit: SL below the engulfing low; scale out aggressively at a conservative first target; breakeven quickly.

name: Inside Bar (Mother Bar) Breakout
entry: Buy stop just above the mother bar high; trigger needs a close outside the range; best after the first 30-60 minutes.
exit: SL beyond the opposite side of the mother bar; TP1 = one mother-bar range; breakeven at 1 range; trail swing lows.

name: Three Bar Play
entry: Igniting bar closes in its top 20% on ~1.5x 20-bar volume; rest bar retraces ≤50%; buy stop just above the rest bar high.
exit: SL just below the rest bar low; TP 2-3R or next swing; take 1/3-1/2 at 1R, move to breakeven.
claimed_stats: Average winner ~1.5-1.7R (Wesley); no win rate

name: Al Brooks High 2 (second entry) pullback
entry: In a bull pullback, after the first attempt (H1) fails, buy stop one tick above the H2 signal bar.
exit: SL below the H2 signal bar or the pullback low; the source gives no target.

name: Bull Flag / Micro Pullback (Warrior)
entry: High relative volume, ideally a news stock; after a 2-3 red candle pullback (≤50%, above VWAP), buy the first candle making a new high.
exit: SL at the pullback low; 2:1 target; sell half at first target, move to breakeven; exit on first red 5m candle.
claimed_stats: Author: 24,268+ trades at ~69% accuracy (author-reported, not typical)

name: Intraday Pennant Breakout
entry: Flagpole ≥5-8% on RVOL ≥3x, then a converging 5-8 candle pennant; buy when a candle closes above it on ≥2x the 5-bar average volume.
exit: SL just below the pennant low; TP 0.5-1x flagpole length, scale half; invalid after 10-20 min with no confirmation.
claimed_stats: Cites Bulkowski daily: >50% break-even failure; ~1/3 reach full target

name: High-of-Day Break Momentum
entry: Buy as price breaks the prior high of day on a fresh volume pickup, or on the first pullback that holds above it.
exit: SL below the pre-break consolidation low; TP = consolidation height added to the breakout; trail behind new consolidation lows.

name: Gap and Go
entry: Stock gapping ~10%+ (small cap); after the 1-5 min opening range, buy the break of its high with volume.
exit: SL below the opening range low (or pre-market high); no fixed TP, scale into strength; exit on a break of the latest higher low.

name: Gap Fade toward Fill
entry: Gap-down version: price fails to hold the pre-market low, then reclaims the opening range low; buy, fading toward the prior close.
exit: SL beyond the opening range extreme; TP1 at the gap midpoint, TP2 at a full fill to the prior close.

name: ES Small-Gap Fill (0.05-0.2%)
entry: If ES opens 0.05-0.2% away from the prior close, enter toward the fill at the close of the first 5m candle; skip if that candle already filled it.
exit: TP at the prior 4pm close (100% fill); SL 12 points ($600/contract).
claimed_stats: 3 months: 14 trades, 71% win, +44% on $10k, max DD 8.53%. Later 90 days: 61% win, PF 1.75. Edgeful: 88% fill rate.

name: Gap Fill Reversal (StockSharp)
entry: Candle opens ≥0.02% from the prior candle's close; once the gap fully closes, enter a reversal opposite to the gap direction.
exit: 2% stop loss, or exit on an opposite signal.
claimed_stats: Vendor: ~181% average annual return, best on crypto; no DD or win rate

name: Initial Balance Extension
entry: After the 9:30-10:30 IB forms, buy when a 5m candle closes above the IB high on volume above the IB average.
exit: SL back inside the IB (near the midpoint); TP ≥1 IB width beyond; exit on re-entry into the IB or an opposite extension.
claimed_stats: Source says no documented win rate

name: 10 AM Reversal Fade
entry: From 9:55 to 10:20 ET, after a catalyst-free opening move, 2+ shrinking candles stall at the morning low; buy the close above the latest lower high.
exit: SL below the stall low; TP1 at VWAP or range midpoint, TP2 at the opening print (≥2:1).

name: Reversal Volume Spike (Z-score ≥3)
entry: At a swing low, a candle with volume Z-score ≥3 (20-period, time-of-day baseline) closes in its upper third; buy at its close.
exit: SL below the spike low; scale 1/3-1/2 at VWAP or nearest swing high; trail higher lows.

name: VWAP Bounce (trend continuation)
entry: Price above VWAP ≥30 min pulls back to within 0.1% of VWAP; a bullish candle on lower volume forms; buy its close or a break of its high.
exit: SL below the bounce low or 0.2% under VWAP; TP1 prior swing high (1.5-2R), TP2 +1SD.
claimed_stats: Target win rate 55-65% (stated target, not results)

name: VWAP Reclaim (reversal)
entry: Price below VWAP ≥15 min; a strong candle closes above VWAP on above-average volume; buy the first pullback that holds above it.
exit: SL 0.15% below VWAP or the reclaim candle low; TP at morning high (2-3R); trail with 5m lows.
claimed_stats: Target win rate 50-60% (stated target)

name: VWAP -2SD Deviation Scalp
entry: Price hits the -2SD VWAP band with a reversal candle on declining volume; buy at its close. Not in the first 30 minutes.
exit: SL 0.1-0.15% beyond the 2SD band (invalid at 3SD); TP1 at -1SD (1-1.5R), trail toward VWAP.
claimed_stats: Target win rate 60-70% (stated target), best on range days

name: VWAP ±3SD Exhaustion Fade
entry: Price reaches -3SD on climax volume (≥5x average) with a bullish hammer and RSI divergence or a contracting MACD histogram; buy the close.
exit: SL beyond the exhaustion extreme +0.2%; scale out in thirds at 2SD, 1SD and VWAP.
claimed_stats: Target win rate 35-45% (stated target)

name: First Pullback to VWAP
entry: Catalyst stock holding above VWAP since the open dips to VWAP on declining volume; a candle closes back above on higher volume; buy stop 1-2c above its high.
exit: SL 1-2c below VWAP or the pullback low; TP at prior HOD or measured move (≥2:1); trail VWAP or 9 EMA.

name: 1-Minute VWAP + 9/21 EMA Cross
entry: Price above VWAP, the 9 EMA crosses above the 21 EMA, and the candle closes above both; enter after the close.
exit: Opposite EMA cross, close back across VWAP, fixed TP/SL, or time exit (test one at a time).

name: 5-Minute VWAP/20EMA Pullback
entry: Price above VWAP and a rising 20 EMA pulls back to either; a bullish candle closes; buy above its high.
exit: SL beyond the pullback swing; fixed R:R target, close below VWAP, or time exit.

name: 9/21 EMA Pullback Scalp
entry: 9 EMA above 21 EMA, both rising; price pulls back to the 9 EMA and a bullish reaction candle forms; buy.
exit: SL below the latest swing low; TP 1.5-2x stop distance or trail swing lows.
claimed_stats: Example R:R 1.55:1

name: Relative Strength vs Index Scalp
entry: A stock holds firm while the index (Nifty) pulls back; buy the stock as the index recovers.
exit: SL at the stock's own latest swing low; TP fixed 2:1 or trail new highs.
claimed_stats: R:R 2:1+ (table)

name: News Spike Fade (first 5-min candle)
entry: Open a 5m chart before the release; after the first 5m candle forms, buy as price nears the spike low.
exit: SL 15 pips below the spike low; TP 2-3x the stop distance.

name: News Straddle (OCO range break)
entry: Before a release, mark the S/R range; buy stop above resistance and sell stop below support; cancel the untriggered order.
exit: Tight SL at the opposite side of the recent range; TP set for positive R:R.

name: Tape Exhaustion Print Burst
entry: RVOL ≥2; a burst of 8+ prints in <10s, each ≥3x the average print size, fails to extend past its own range; take the reversal side on the next print.
exit: SL one tick beyond the burst extreme; TP at the latest swing or 1R; trail as print pace slows.

name: Level 2 Bid Absorption
entry: RVOL ≥1.5; a bid gets hit by 3+ aggressive sells (confirmed on tape) but refills, with net size down ≤50%; buy.
exit: SL one tick below the absorbed level; TP at latest swing high or 1R; exit if size is pulled or the level is cleared.

name: Footprint Stacked Imbalance Absorption
entry: 3+ consecutive levels with a ≥300% imbalance at a session low, and the next bar fails to extend; enter the reversal.
exit: SL beyond the imbalance bar extreme; TP at the bar's POC or 1R; trail each new bar's POC.

name: CVD Divergence Reversal
entry: Price prints a new session low while CVD makes a higher low (confirmed over 2 extremes), and price stalls; buy.
exit: SL beyond the diverging price extreme; TP at the prior swing of the last confirming CVD point or 1R; trail CVD swings.

name: Cumulative Delta Breakout
entry: Go long when cumulative delta breaks above its highest value of the 20-bar lookback.
exit: Close when delta crosses back through zero, or at the stop loss.
claimed_stats: Vendor: ~49% average annual return, best on crypto; no DD or win rate

name: Top-of-Book Imbalance Taker (NautilusTrader)
entry: When the larger best-level size >100 and the smaller/larger ratio <0.20 with bid heavier, buy at best ask (FOK) for the thin side's size.
exit: No signal exit defined; the strategy cancels and flattens on stop. 1s cooldown between triggers.

name: Order Flow Imbalance Scalp (Nifty futures)
entry: Bid depth ≥2:1 over ask, a 10-30s cluster of aggressive buys at the ask, and the ask moving up; buy.
exit: SL fixed 3-5 points, or exit if the flow reverses; TP 3-8 points as the imbalance fades.
claimed_stats: R:R 1:1 to 2:1 (table)

name: Iceberg Bid Follow
entry: A hidden bid (iceberg) keeps absorbing aggressive selling near PDL, VWAP or a round number while price holds or ticks up; go long, confirmed by delta or imbalance.
exit: Not specified by source.

name: Bait Wall / Spoof Pull Fade
entry: A large wall disappears and price breaks out but volume does not follow; fade the breakout as a trap.
exit: Not specified by source.

name: Breakout with Acceptance (order flow)
entry: Two bars close beyond the level, a stacked imbalance of ≥3 rows points in the break direction, delta agrees on both bars, and volume is at least average.
exit: Setup expires after 6 bars; the source gives no SL/TP.

name: Failed Breakout with Delta Non-confirmation
entry: A bar pokes through a level and closes back inside, delta does not follow the break, and volume beyond the level is thin; trade the reversal.
exit: Invalid if a bar closes beyond the 'wrong if' price; expires after 6 bars.

name: Bid-Ask Spread Capture Execution
entry: When another setup signals, enter with a limit at the bid instead of the market; best in liquid stocks with a 1-cent spread.
exit: Exit with a limit at the ask; switch to market if unfilled on time-sensitive setups. SL/TP come from the underlying strategy.
claimed_stats: Example saves ~2 cents/share; source says pure spread scalping isn't viable for retail

name: Hummingbot Pure Market Making
entry: Place a bid at mid minus bid_spread and an ask at mid plus ask_spread on one spot pair.
exit: Cancel and replace every order_refresh_time; fills capture the spread; 60s filled_order_delay default.

name: PMM with Inventory Skew & Price Band
entry: Size bids and asks to pull inventory back toward inventory_target_base_pct; only buy below price_floor and only sell above price_ceiling.
exit: Orders refresh when price moves past order_refresh_tolerance_pct; cancel when spread < minimum_spread.

name: Ping-Pong Orders
entry: Quote both sides; after a buy fills, cancel the remaining orders and quote only the sell side (and vice versa).
exit: Resume two-sided quoting once the opposite side fills.

name: Hanging Orders Market Making
entry: Quote a pair; when one side fills, leave the opposite order on the book while placing a fresh pair.
exit: Cancel a hanging order only when its spread from mid exceeds hanging_orders_cancel_pct (default 10).

name: Avellaneda-Stoikov Market Making
entry: Quote around a reservation price that shifts with inventory versus target (50% default); optimal spread comes from volatility, liquidity and time left; risk_factor γ sets skew.
exit: Orders refresh continuously; max_order_age 1800s; 60s filled_order_delay; min_spread floor.

name: Cross-Exchange Market Making (XEMM)
entry: Post maker limit orders on the less liquid exchange, priced min_profitability beyond the hedge price on the liquid taker exchange.
exit: Hedge each fill immediately with a taker market order; cancel makers that drop below min_profitability.

name: Spot-Perpetual Arbitrage
entry: When the spot-perp spread exceeds min_opening_arbitrage_pct (default 1), buy spot and short the perp (or the reverse).
exit: Close both legs when the spread falls below min_closing_arbitrage_pct (default 0.1).

name: Hummingbot Grid Strike (V2)
entry: Long grid of limit-maker buys between start_price and end_price, spaced ≥0.1%; optional activation bounds place only nearby levels.
exit: Per-fill take profit 0.1% (limit-maker); optional SL, time limit or trailing stop; close all if price breaks limit_price.

name: Dman V3 Bollinger Mean-Reversion Levels
entry: Mean-reversion entries that place several order levels, with spread and step sizes scaled to the Bollinger Band value.
exit: Not detailed on the source page.

name: Arithmetic Spot Grid
entry: Split the price range into equal-dollar levels (e.g. $100-200, 5 grids = $20 steps); resting buys at each level below price.
exit: Each filled buy is sold at the next level up.

name: Geometric Spot Grid
entry: Space levels by a fixed percentage (example 5% step), so lower prices get more buy orders.
exit: Sell each fill one percentage step higher.

name: DCA Bot with Safety Orders (3Commas-style)
entry: Buy a base order; add safety orders at each price-deviation % drop, with step-scale spacing and volume-scale sizing (e.g. 2x).
exit: TP % on the averaged position, recomputed after each fill; optional SL below the last safety order (off by default).

name: Queue-Based Market Making (large-tick asset)
entry: Quote a 10-level grid at best bid/ask every 100ms (GTX); if best-level size <250k and position skew is adverse, step that side back one tick.
exit: Cancel orders off the new grid; position capped at ±10 units.
claimed_stats: CRVUSDT Jul-Aug 2024: Sharpe 13.20, return 3.95, max DD 0.180, ~1,841 trades/day (baseline Sharpe 16.39)

name: High-Frequency Skewed Grid Market Making
entry: 20 post-only levels per side, 10-tick spacing, 20-tick half spread around reservation = mid - skew·tick·position; refresh every 100ms.
exit: Grid re-quotes; position capped at 5 units; quotes never cross the BBO.
claimed_stats: ETHUSDT Oct 2022 (5 days), skew=10: Sharpe 27.28, return 4.26%, max DD 0.54%, ~11,839 trades/day

name: GLFT-Simplified Volatility Grid MM
entry: Half spread = 5x 10-min mid volatility; skew bid/ask depth by normalized position; quote around BBO micro-price; 20 GTX levels.
exit: Re-grid continuously; stop buying or selling at normalized position ±1.

name: Imbalance-Adjusted Micro-Price Fair Value
entry: Fair price = mid + spread·I·(I^8+1)/4, where I=(Qb-Qa)/(Qb+Qa); use it to center quotes or signal direction.
exit: Not defined; the author says it's not yet usable in real trading.
claimed_stats: Only qualitative: 'slightly better' than weighted mid on YGG/USDT, 9M ticks

name: Bitcoin Cross-Exchange Lead-Lag
entry: Forecast mid-quote moves on lagging BTC exchanges from leading-exchange moves (lags up to 15s); trade the lagging venue.
exit: Not specified in the abstract.
claimed_stats: Directional accuracy up to 70%; profitable only with lowest fees and mid-quote execution

name: Wide-Spread Alt-Pair PMM (liquidity mining setup)
entry: PMM on USDT alt pairs, with spreads set at the 4th-6th book position from mid and $60-100 orders; refresh every 65-125s.
exit: filled_order_delay 180-360s; price bounds 3-5% from mid; kill switch at -2 to -3.
